raw_posts.name: Gauth Unlimited Digital Canvas
raw_posts.tagline: An AI tutor on an infinite whiteboard, not a chat thread
raw_posts.description: Gauth AI Course now runs on an Unlimited Digital Canvas: one continuous whiteboard where lessons unfold spatially instead of in a chat thread or slide deck. Chapters expand side by side as narration plays, board notes write out in sync with the AI voice, and you can zoom from the full concept map down to a single formula. Pause anytime to ask the AI Tutor, and it answers right on the board beneath your step. Generate a canvas lesson on any topic, then export it as a PDF or share a link.

raw_posts.name: Veltrix AI for E-commerce
raw_posts.tagline: Find how your e-commerce business could earn more
raw_posts.description: Find ways to make your e-commerce business more profitable. Veltrix uses AI to analyze your sales, costs, customers and marketing. Get help deciding what to promote, where to cut spending and how to solve problems holding the business back. Connect your business tools or upload files. Start with a Business Health Check to find improvements you may have missed. Then use Veltrix to work out what to improve. Your first check is free. No card required.

raw_posts.name: Teachoo
raw_posts.tagline: AI that helps you learn anything and everything.
raw_posts.description: Teachoo helps students work through homework one question at a time. Type a problem or upload a photo, then work toward the answer with guided questions, feedback and hints. Need more help? Ask for a bigger hint or an explanation of the step. Free to use. Try a problem you haven’t solved in years.

raw_posts.name: Famulor
raw_posts.tagline: Your agent to answer calls and follow ups on WhatsApp
raw_posts.description: Famulor answers calls, runs campaigns and follows up on WhatsApp. GDPR-ready, EU hosting. Try it free.

raw_posts.name: Eleven v4 and Eleven v4 Turbo
raw_posts.tagline: Elevenlabs' fastest and most emotive voice models yet
raw_posts.description: Meet Eleven v4 and Eleven v4 Turbo by ElevenLabs, their most expressive models yet, with Turbo built for real-time use. Available in apps, API, and agents.

raw_posts.name: Mintlify Desktop
raw_posts.tagline: An AI-native app for writing documentation and knowledge
raw_posts.description: A dedicated home for all your documentation, from internal knowledge bases, runbooks and onboarding guides to public docs. Keep projects open side by side across organizations and pick up where you left off. An agent works alongside you on the page you’re editing, while local files let you write offline and sync when you reconnect. Tabs, split views, and persistent sessions help you move between projects without losing context.

raw_posts.name: ShipHQ
raw_posts.tagline: Build your own app studio, powered by your real apps
raw_posts.description: ShipHQ turns your app's real numbers into a living isometric startup office. Connect RevenueCat and every paying subscriber becomes a person at your desks. Each morning the Daily Brief replays last night: new subscribers walk in to applause, trials arrive in caps, churn gets a send-off. Milestones land as trophies on your wall — earned, never bought, never retroactive. AI managers bring a 09:00 standup on growth, reviews and competitors. Free on iPhone.

raw_posts.name: Bambu Lab R1
raw_posts.tagline: CO2 laser cutting with Bambu-style automation
raw_posts.description: Bambu Lab R1 is a 55W CO2 laser cutter built around automation. It handles optical alignment, material positioning and surface tracking for you, with a 600 × 300 mm work area, clear acrylic support, and optional conveyor processing up to 3 meters.

raw_posts.name: Clef
raw_posts.description: Clef is a 27B multimodal model that turns a state and a schema of typed questions into decisions. It reads the state as text, JSON, images, or video, and returns a probability for every allowed option of every question in a single forward pass. There is no free-form text generation and no output parsing. The Clef API is fully compatible with Jev and SystemOne.

raw_posts.name: Open Inspector
raw_posts.tagline: Hover any website, get its design system. Open-source. Free.
raw_posts.description: A free, open-source browser extension for inspecting layout, styles, colour, type and assets on any page, and exporting its design tokens. Unlike the popular alternatives, it requests no site access and makes zero network requests. MIT, no account.
